bayts.text: Thus says the servant of Allah, namely Aḥmad, the servant of him whose name is Muḥammad:
In the name of God – and He is the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), and He is the Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm) –: security has yielded to me.
Praise be to Allah for the Book, together with the Intercessor who takes away reproach,
our master Muḥammad, the best of creation, he whose service, and the sūras (of the Qurʾān), have led (good) to me.
Then the blessing of Allah and peace upon him to whom belong, from me, the pens,
our master, our intercessor, set foremost with Him in Whose presence my services grow pure,
Muḥammad, my means of approach and my shield against enemies and harm, and my garden,
and upon his Family and his righteous Companions, in the present and in the final outcome, again and again.
And after this: my intent is a service by which the eye of the Prophet may be gladdened, just as it is dutiful.
I have resolved, from this year, upon a service that gladdens him whose intercession is accepted, through whom I have been spared what is hard.
I have sought from the Lord of creatures a service for him by whose rank He has spared me a blow.
I praise Him for deliverance from harm and from every evil, hardship and peril.
I thank Him with a thanks that draws an increase of joy, and draws no plot toward me.
A praise and a thanks that hold fast to dutifulness toward the Lord of creatures and drive delusion away.
So I rose to set this introduction in verse, invoking blessings by it upon him whom (Allah) set foremost,
hoping to be a loftier servant and to win the loftiest abode,
asking my Master to benefit by it whoever wishes to draw benefit.
May Allah make it, by the rank of the Chosen One – may He bless him with a chosen peace –,
a blessed composition that guards against punishment, just as it has melted away what afflicted me,
a poem in rajaz that worships Allah, together with the Book and the Messenger of Allah.
I have named it "The Attractor of Desires" (Jālibat al-Marāghib), in the hereafter as in the here and now, for whoever desires.
I have turned to the aim, saying, with purity, by night or in the midday rest:
O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Beloved!
You have commanded us to invoke blessings upon our master, he who rose above creation,
Muḥammad, and to invoke peace upon him (Qurʾān 33:56), O Everlasting (Al-Bāqī) Who has made his loftiness endure for ever.
For ever, then, bless him and grant him peace, O Generous One, on my behalf, and lead to me what I seek.
Bless him, together with all the Family, with peace, and answer my request.
Bless him, together with all the Companions, with peace, and make my path clear.
And forgive every believing man and woman, with a forgiveness that keeps them constant in every good.
And forgive every Muslim man and woman, with a forgiveness that guards them from oppressors.
And forgive every man and woman who does good, with a forgiveness that leads goodness to them.
O Allah, bless for ever and grant peace to a Prophet whose precedence is well known,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You with Whom the best of prophets sought refuge from the Accursed, the deceiver, the worst of fools,
bless with peace the Prophet, the Family and the Companions, and guard what is hidden within me.
O You Who protected the best of creation from all people together (Qurʾān 5:67), and magnified his station,
bless him and grant him peace for ever, with his Family and whoever is affiliated to him.
And bless, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), with peace, him who was sent as a teacher,
our master Muḥammad, and the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You Who commanded the best of creation (to say) "I seek refuge in Allah", just as You protected him by it and by "Allah suffices us",
Bless him and grant him peace at every time, together with the Family, the Companions and the righteous.
And bless, O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), with peace, him whom my pens gladden,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, O You Who have been generous with the (good) final outcome.
O best of those who send down (Revelation), Who protected with "I seek refuge in Allah", and best of those who send down, Who bestowed the basmala,
bless with peace him who surpassed (all) in his form and in his character, by unanimous accord,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome,
just as he sought refuge in You from Satan, and illumined hearts as well as lands,
and just as You blessed him, the Companions and his Family, as much as the rain of the cloud.
Spread over us the blessings of the basmala, and free us from need of armed raid through "I seek refuge in Allah".
Spread over us the blessings of the Fātiḥa, and make our buckets draw up sweet water.
And enrich us with You, together with what is chosen for us, by the sanctity of the Prophet, the Chosen One.
And bless him for ever with peace, just as You led to him the most excellent of speech.
